FREELANCE CONTRACT

This Agreement is between Client Corp ('Client') and Jane Doe ('Contractor').

1. Services. Contractor shall provide graphic design services.

2. Compensation. Client shall pay Contractor $5,000 upon completion.

3. Intellectual Property. All work product, designs, and creative materials produced by Contractor under this Agreement shall be the sole and exclusive property of Client. Contractor hereby assigns all rights, title, and interest including copyrights to Client. Contractor retains no rights to use the work for any purpose including portfolio display.

4. Non-Compete. Contractor agrees that during the term of this Agreement and for a period of __________ months following termination, Contractor shall not perform similar services for any business anywhere in the world.

5. Indemnification. Contractor shall indemnify and hold harmless Client from any and all claims, damages, losses, and expenses, including attorney's fees, arising out of Contractor's performance under this Agreement. Client's liability to Contractor is limited to fees paid.

6. Governing Law. This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of Delaware.

description: Well-drafted freelance contract with mutual protections
contract_text:
FREELANCE CONTRACT

This Agreement is between Acme Corp ('Client') and Jane Smith ('Contractor') effective January 1, 2025.

1. Services. Contractor shall provide web design services as described in Schedule A. Changes require written change orders agreed by both parties.

2. Compensation. Client shall pay $8,000: 25% on signing, 25% at midpoint, 50% on delivery. Invoices due within 14 days. Late payments accrue interest at 1.5% per month.

3. Termination. Either party may terminate with 30 days written notice. If Client terminates for convenience after work begins, Client pays for work completed plus a kill fee of 25% of remaining contract value.

4. Intellectual Property. Upon full payment, Contractor assigns all rights to final deliverables to Client. Contractor retains the right to display work in portfolio and use general skills and know-how acquired.

5. Non-Compete. For 6 months following termination, Contractor shall not solicit Client's existing clients with whom Contractor had direct contact. This does not restrict Contractor from performing services for other businesses.

6. Limitation of Liability. Each party's total liability shall not exceed total fees paid under this Agreement. Neither party shall be liable for indirect or consequential damages. This mutual cap applies equally to both parties.

7. Confidentiality. Contractor shall keep Client's confidential information confidential for 2 years following termination.

8. Governing Law. This Agreement is governed by the laws of New York.

contract_text:
CONSULTING AGREEMENT

This agreement between TechCorp ('Client') and Alice Wong ('Consultant').
1. Services: Business strategy consulting, 3-month engagement.
2. Fee: $15,000 flat fee, 50% on signing, 50% on completion.
3. IP: All deliverables, reports, and methodologies developed are owned by Client.
4. Non-Compete: For 12 months post-termination, Consultant shall not advise companies in the fintech sector within North America.
5. Confidentiality: Consultant shall maintain confidentiality for 5 years post-termination.
6. Limitation of Liability: Consultant's liability capped at fees paid. No consequential damages.
7. Governing Law: California.
rubric: Negotiation suggestions should: (1) cite verbatim text from the contract, (2) only flag clauses that are actually present, (3) note the 12-month North America non-compete is borderline but not excessive (should be medium at most), (4) note the 5-year confidentiality is somewhat long (recommend 2 years), (5) note IP clause lacks portfolio rights. Suggestions should NOT invent clauses that don't exist.
